cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (20480 MB = 20 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

queryport.desc: Steam query port (UDP), used by the server browser

servername.desc: Name shown in the server browser

serverpassword.desc: Password players need to join. Empty means anyone can join

adminpassword.desc: Password for in-game admin login (adminlogin in the console). Change it

map.desc: Map loaded at startup, for example FFA_ThePit or SKM_Grad

commands: bash -c "for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do steamcmd +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /SkyPanel +login anonymous +app_update 629800 validate +quit && exit 0; echo 'steamcmd could not finish the download, trying again in 15s ($try/5)'; sleep 15; done; exit 1"

bash -c "mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64; for d in .steam .steam/steamcmd .local/share/Steam/steamcmd steamcmd; do if [ -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/; fi; if [ -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/; fi; done; true"
